headline: ZF Market Opening Today. Adrian Codirlaşu, CFA Romania: I Think There Will Be Higher Taxes Next Year, Because the Money from the PNRR Is Disappearing. The Solution Is Fiscal, Not Monetary, by Reducing Spending
summary: CFA Romania president Adrian Codirlaşu expects higher taxes next year as budget revenue from PNRR recovery funds falls. He said the deficit should be addressed by cutting spending.
why: The PNRR is the EU recovery plan funding Romanian projects, and Romania's budget deficit influences its sovereign debt rating and bond yields.
